## Data-Ink Ratio
- Concept introduced by Edward Tufte
- In a graphic, large portion of the ink should present data-information
- Data ink = bars, lines, dots (actual data)
- Non-data ink = borders, gridlines, backgrounds,
decorative elements
- Criticisms on minimalism: [Paper](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/1362550.1362587)
    - The idea here is that data should be used thoughtfully
